entries.text: Mermaid flowchart, sequence, state and ER diagrams are drawn as terminal art in chat
Non-interactive runs apply saved compaction and `toolSearch` settings like interactive sessions
Prompts with `chat.disableWrap` on or in lite session panes no longer copy with two leading spaces
Herdr shows a session as blocked while a permission or question prompt is waiting
Model fallback now handles refusals that return no response text
Compaction no longer saves the model's refusal as the conversation summary
`/sandbox` setup on Windows no longer fails where policy blocks running programs from the temp folder
`/changelog` shows each entry on its own line
IAM Identity Center sign-in now works in isolated AWS partitions
`/sandbox` and local `/autonomous` mode are now available to all users, off by default
MCP tools now load on demand for every user, keeping unused tool schemas out of requests
`KIRO_HOME` now also relocates MCP config, permissions, sessions, powers and agent state
A saved `sandbox.json` with `enabled: true` now applies to headless runs
`--no-interactive` chat on the V1 engine now exits non-zero with the error that ended the turn instead of a misleading tool-approval error
MCP sign-ins are saved under `KIRO_HOME` when set; existing ones are copied over once
Animated WebP images are now sent to the model as PNG
Cloud config and other Kiro service requests fail after 15 seconds instead of hanging
MCP tools on streamable-HTTP servers keep working after the server drops its session
A relative, root, or home-folder `KIRO_HOME` is ignored and `~/.kiro` is used instead
In cloud sessions, the code intelligence indicator and `/code` panel now reflect the cloud workspace
GitHub and Google sign-ins are no longer signed out when the auth service returns a temporary error during token refresh
Notices in the transcript when a model refuses or is unavailable and the turn moves to another model
Agent upgrades refresh permissions after V2 setting changes until you edit them
Kiro CLI may now offer to switch you to V3 when you start a chat
Screen readers now follow streaming replies in the full TUI via the Screen reader option in `/settings display`
Agent upgrades preserve V2 workspace read access and `fs_read` skill trust
Scrolling back in `tmux` no longer shows a screen of blank rows after long replies
Launching after output without a trailing newline no longer draws the UI at an offset
Knowledge search no longer silently drops a chunk from a small knowledge base
Garbled text and stray characters around icons in chat on some Linux terminals and remote desktops
MCP OAuth sign-in in classic and Rust V2 now works with servers that require an issuer
`/settings` Display > Full Screen lets you turn off Copy on select for terminal or tmux copying
Classic sessions offer to switch you to 3.0 and upgrade your agent configs
Hook matchers accept tool tags such as `shell`, `read`, `@builtin` and `@mcp`
`/model` and `/effort` pickers open mid-turn, with selections applied after the turn ends
Conversations no longer stop responding after a sub-agent finishes in V2 TUI sessions
Expanded activity trays no longer limit task lists to six rows, with a screen-sized limit in fullscreen
Windows V2 stdio MCP servers preserve `|`, `&`, `%`, and spaces in arguments when resolved to `.exe`, `.com`, `.bat`, or `.cmd` without a configured `PATHEXT`
Voice recording hints point to `kiro-cli settings voice.*` instead of the nonexistent `/settings voice`
Returning from the agent monitor or session dashboard no longer misplaces the chat view on some terminals
Interrupted tool calls report accurate outcomes, live and after reload
Reduced memory growth during very long agent sessions
`/tangent merge [dest]` to fold a tangent's findings into its parent or a named session
Non-interactive runs support hooks, knowledge, code intelligence
`/chat save -f <path>` now overwrites an existing file like `--force` instead of failing
`/chat save` now works when Kiro is launched from a different directory than the one the session was started in
Non-interactive runs now exit 4 when the named agent (`--agent`, or the v3 `chat.defaultAgent`) is unavailable, instead of answering on the default agent
Reopening a tangent after `/tangent merge` shows its summarization line, not the full prompt
Remote MCP servers that answer the path-based OAuth discovery URL with their root issuer (such as self-managed GitLab) no longer fail sign-in with an issuer mismatch on the V2 engine
Batched `Directory` operations in the `read` tool no longer run into each other
Non-interactive runs exit 1, instead of warning and answering, when `--agent` fails to apply for a reason other than the agent being unavailable
`/upgrade-agent diagnostics` no longer blanks the screen and freezes input a few seconds after opening
New and resumed sessions, once the model list is known, tell you when their model is unavailable or was changed and point to `/model`; an unavailable saved default falls back to the default model
Resuming a session with many workflow runs no longer waits to load every finished step's credits
Workflows in `--no-interactive` runs now stay attached through completion wakes and late `--trust-all-tools` approvals; set `KIRO_HEADLESS_WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT_SECS` to lower the six-hour drain bound
Workflow progress and complete wake-turn usage accounting in `--no-interactive` runs
Make `--no-interactive` workflows honor feature settings, isolate child output, and report incomplete outcomes
Model fallback: a refused or over-capacity turn now retries on another model by default; `/model fallback` picks the target
Pasting text that contains terminal escape sequences, such as colored output or hyperlinks, no longer leaves sequence debris in the prompt
Failed shell commands show both stdout and stderr alongside their exit status, and shell output no longer ends with a blank row
A failed shell command shows its output and the failure together under one `output:` label
Long text in an indented row keeps every wrapped line; the row below no longer paints over it
Transcript spacing no longer shifts up by a row when an entry is committed to scrollback
Pass `--effort` to the engine in non-interactive runs
Subagent spawned with an unknown agent role now returns a visible error instead of silently using the default agent's tools
Selective mode in web_fetch no longer returns unbounded output that caused every subsequent turn to fail with "Improperly formed request" on large documents
Prevent a CLI shutdown stall during slow telemetry exports handled by a native flush worker
`/context` no longer lists global steering files twice when run from the home directory
Steering files now expand `#[[file:...]]` and `#[[folder:...]]` references
Workflow steps now retry through network outages for up to 24 hours instead of pausing
Output style now lives under `/settings display` instead of the top-level `/settings` menu
Herdr can restore existing cloud conversations after a server restart
Workflows sub-agent tool toggle in `/settings` features to limit chat delegation to workflows
Agent configs saved by renaming a file into an agents directory now hot-reload without a restart
`--resume` now picks the most recent session matching the launch environment, local or cloud
`agent list` now includes agents that use the v3 config format instead of hiding them
Write cards in the full TUI show only a diff's changed lines with context, not the whole file
Copy works in `/fullscreen`: dragging over a message copies what was said, not where it wrapped
Write cards in the full TUI cap a diff at 40 rows; `ctrl+o` or `chat.autoExpandToolOutput` shows the rest while the card is live
Saved prompt files and MCP server prompts now appear as slash commands with argument hints
Sessions start up to ~0.5s faster with large `permissions.yaml` files
A workflow step answered after the agent restarts now reports its progress and completion
Recovering from a stalled model response keeps completed tool results instead of rerunning them
The context-gatherer subagent no longer finishes without returning its findings
Trust-all no longer repeats tool approval requests when the agent engine omits a persistable capability
Herdr can restore existing local conversations after a server restart
Enter starts authentication for the selected OAuth server in `/mcp`
ACP clients on the V2 engine now get `stopReason: refusal` for content-filtered responses, not `end_turn`
Sessions no longer become unrecoverable when a preToolUse hook blocks one of multiple requested tools
`--model` is honored in `--no-interactive` runs on the V2 engine instead of the default model
Trusts the OS certificate store, so corporate TLS-inspecting proxies no longer cause "No model available"
TUI reports invalid or locally missing `--resume-id` values instead of starting a new conversation
Enables multi-step asynchronous workflows with reusable recipes. `/settings` â†’ features to enable
Approved path grants now apply when the same file is reached through a symlink or alias
Tool-returned images survive session reload
Install and uninstall powers from chat with `/powers install` and `/powers uninstall`
Output styles in `/settings`, including new styles supplied by upgraded agents
`/settings display` â†’ Full Screen â†’ Scroll speed moves the fullscreen transcript 1, 2 or 3 rows per mouse wheel event (default 2; previously always 1)
`SessionEnd` hook trigger fires on session teardown
Capacity errors on the V2 (Rust) engine name the affected model and count down the retry wait
Retry notices on the V2 (Rust) engine name a model capacity drop instead of rate limiting, and count the original send as attempt 1
Model refusals name the model that declined the request
Transcript indicators use agent ghosts, synchronized tool dim sweeps, and neutral reasoning dots
`/sessions` opens faster in workspaces with large session histories
`/settings display` groups Start fullscreen under a new Full Screen screen
A model list that cannot be fetched no longer stops a session from starting
`fs_read` now reports `(empty)` when listing an empty directory instead of returning no output
Loading a v2 or classic session over ACP on the v3 engine now replays its history instead of starting an empty session
Markdown table rows with escaped backticks or even backslash runs now split into the correct columns, while rows still streaming inline code stay stable
Workspace `.kiroignore` now blocks the agent from reading and searching matching files
Identity changes re-pin auth routing atomically
MCP OAuth honors every documented `redirectUri` format
V2 user agent configs shadowing built-in agent names
`/clear` keeps the model and effort you are currently using
`/chat new` keeps the current model and returns to its saved effort
`--model` and `--effort` no longer carry over to later sessions
`--cloud` and `--repo` now work without the `chat` subcommand on Windows, matching macOS and Linux
Status line shows `thinking` only when thinking is on, instead of a chip for the off and default states
`/effort` with no level opens the `/model` picker focused on the active model's Effort row
`/sessions` opens faster by listing this directory's sessions by default; toggle to see all
Completed reasoning rows are marked with the agent response dot instead of the tool status dot in the chat transcript
Agent response marker now degrades to an ASCII character in ASCII mode
Fullscreen scrolling no longer drops wheel notches while a response is streaming
Back-to-back steering messages reach the agent right away instead of waiting on the previous one
Messages typed while a conversation is compacting are queued and sent once compaction finishes
Link underline styling no longer bleeds into surrounding text and table borders
`/tools trust-all` to auto-approve every tool request for the rest of the session
`/sessions` filter, sort, and group now list their options, and filters can be combined
Render terminal frames with less repeated layout and text work, and paint a resize once at its new width
Fullscreen wheel scrolling moves one transcript row per notch instead of three
Show no model instead of a stale one when the account's model list can't be determined
User agent configs with reserved built-in names (`kiro_default`, `kiro_planner`, `kiro_guide`) are now rejected with a clear error instead of silently shadowing the built-in agent
Tool details use available space with one shared expansion hint
Honor `chat.defaultModel` in new non-interactive sessions
Downscale oversized images and recover sessions broken by image dimension errors
`kiro-cli settings` now recognizes settings configured through the interactive `/settings` menu
Project `.env` files no longer override the environment of chat sessions, MCP servers, and tools
Ctrl+L now clears the screen without erasing scrollback history
`/effort` marks the effort saved in `chat.modelDefaults` as `[default]` instead of the engine default
The packaged chat updater now defers Homebrew-managed installs to Homebrew
Queued steering messages stay visible in the activity tray while the agent is working
Long conversations no longer show a misleading archived-turns row while full history remains available through `/transcript` and `/rewind`
Agent config upgrade keeps permission rules when a sibling setting in the same tool section is malformed
`/upgrade-agent` finds agents in legacy `.amazonq/cli-agents` and custom agent directories
Upgrading a symlinked agent config rewrites the linked file instead of replacing the symlink
`/sessions` can filter the list to main sessions
Allowed commands prefixed with an environment variable no longer prompt on every run, reverting a 2.23.0 change
Chats on extended-thinking models no longer fail every turn after Tool Search loads a tool mid-conversation
Chats on extended-thinking models no longer fail every turn after a reply that thinks more than once
Classic `--resume-id` now reports missing, unreadable, empty, or V2-only sessions instead of starting fresh
Stale extracted V3 engine versions are now cleaned up regardless of which engine a session starts with
The classic chat path also stops replaying a thinking block bound to a different tool list
Reasoning settings (thinking and effort) in the `/model` surface
Live duration in the TUI prompt showing how long Kiro has been working, excluding approval waits
Animated spinner in the terminal title while Kiro is working when `chat.terminalTitle` is on
Progress indicators in ConEmu terminals with ANSI processing enabled
Upgraded `/kiro` Easter egg with an animated roaming ghost overlay
Smaller CLI installation size
Cloud sessions no longer require a connected source provider to start; `/repo` opens the connect screen when none is connected, and the startup checklist notes a repository can be attached
`/sessions` opens faster, especially with large session histories
Improved message streaming performance
Improved fullscreen scrolling performance
The CLI no longer crashes at startup on hosts without a system CA bundle
`settings open` now correctly handles `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` values that include arguments (e.g. `emacs -nw`)
`/chat load` with an extension-less name now loads the `.json` file `/chat save` wrote
Tool calls in a legacy V1 conversation loaded on the V2 engine no longer replay as cancelled
Honor the `api.krs.service` and `api.cps.service` endpoint overrides
A turn that ends silently after successful tool use now completes instead of erroring
Non-interactive runs show the failure reason and error code instead of a bare "Internal error"
`/model` lists models even when the service names no default, using the first available one
Resuming a session keeps the status shown by `/config` and `/hooks`, including disabled hooks
`str_replace` now matches text in files with mixed line endings
Custom agents are preserved when a session's mode is reapplied
A session card recorded just before a load now replays correctly
The response sanitizer no longer presents fabricated turns as the model's own speech
`chat.defaultAgent` is now honored in non-interactive runs, including a stale default agent's errors
Feedback typed when denying a tool call now reaches the model so it can adjust its next action
Progress indicator stays visible while Kiro keeps working after automatic compaction
Terminal progress indicator now goes idle while a turn is being cancelled instead of continuing to spin
Agent switching by display name without stale fallback warnings
Fullscreen scrolling ignores the horizontal component of a diagonal trackpad gesture instead of scrolling down for it
Notices in the transcript when a turn moves to a different model
Capacity errors identify the affected model
Shell tool cards show plain-language command descriptions
Honor `--require-mcp-startup` so non-interactive runs wait for MCP servers to connect before prompting
Background process output appears in `get_process_output` tool cards
Cloud sessions recover from mid-turn connection resets
Compaction retries truncated summaries instead of keeping incomplete context
MCP connections work with authorization servers that reject `offline_access`
Type `/fullscreen` to expand the chat to the whole terminal with mouse scrolling; run it again to return.
Support `KIRO_SKIP_BINARY_PINNING=1` to disable session binary pinning for environments with fixed install paths
Refreshed `/sessions` with simpler controls and a streamlined session view
Backing out of a `/settings` screen returns the cursor to the row you left instead of the top
Replayed and resumed transcripts no longer leave a blank line above a turn's divider, matching live turns
Large tool results are now always saved to a session file with a short preview for the model
`--require-mcp-startup` now works in non-interactive runs: they wait for MCP servers to connect and fail closed on startup failure, instead of running without MCP tools
A turn that stalls after a complete tool call now runs the tool and continues instead of failing
Prompts behind a proxy that requires credentials report a proxy authentication error instead of "Internal error"
The cloud-config pull card appears only when sync is enabled, not on every session start
Esc out of the status line settings panel returns to Display instead of jumping to `/settings`
Stopped thinking-only message boundaries from rendering an empty assistant response marker before tool calls
A symlinked agent config that uses a `file://` prompt now loads the prompt from the config file location
`/context` lists global steering files and workspace steering files without frontmatter
Custom agents are told their working directory, so command-tool `cwd` guesses no longer fail in worktrees
Automatic compaction now keeps the active response and Thinking indicator visible, then continues queued prompts without requiring Esc
Long shell commands and metadata now share one Ctrl+O expansion hint
Resuming a session now separates the session-start cloud config card from the previous turn instead of rendering it flush under that turn's usage summary
Mislabeled image files now attach using their actual format instead of breaking the chat
Reduced memory growth in long-running TUI sessions with heavy subagent use
Session search now includes agent responses by default; choose what it searches in `/settings`
`--v2` flag to explicitly select the V2 agent engine, overriding persisted settings

Settings menus now share one keyboard contract: Left/Right change a value, Enter selects or opens a submenu, and Esc goes back. The `/verbosity` preview moves to `ctrl+x` (`ctrl+p` still works for now).
Removed the left status rail and replaced it with a small agent-colored response indicator
Dismiss pending approval and question prompts when a turn fails so you are not stranded on a dead modal
The tangent indicator (â†¯ tangent-N) is now shown when resuming a tangent session with `--resume-id`, `/chat`, or the session picker
Installed powers appear in the `/` command picker
`code` tool results appear on completed tool cards
Agent `model:` pins resolve against the served model list
Failed tool calls show a plain error message instead of raw JSON
Kiro can now read Java definitions inside external library JARs when navigating code
MCP tool listing refreshes when MCP is disabled mid-session
Model, mode, and effort selections survive an immediate restart
Sessions created moments before a session list request are no longer missing
Shell commands no longer always prompt for approval under `logbash` and `logzsh`
`/usage` non-interactive output again shows the full breakdown (plan, limits, and usage percentages) instead of a one-line summary
Welcome screen no longer animates the wordmark on first launch
Terminal theme detection now reconciles the fast COLORFGBG startup signal with an authoritative OSC 11 response after first paint
Shell tool streaming output now updates partial lines in place instead of expanding into multiple entries
Terminal history is now preserved across redraws by default; set `chat.preserveScrollback` to false to restore the previous clear-and-repaint behavior
`/settings` no longer toggles a value on one screen and ignores Enter on another; every settings footer now names what Enter does on the focused row
ACP session creation no longer advertises a hardcoded model list when the model-list fetch fails; it retries briefly, then reports the list as unknown
Announce agent switches made through the ACP protocol so the TUI stops showing the previous agent
Kiro is ready for input up to 20Ã— faster by removing redundant binary hashing and moving backend connection work behind the first usable frame
Chat no longer jumps up and back down when the prompt footer hint disappears while you type or a turn runs
The reasoning block's "ctrl+o to view" hint now disappears as the turn leaves the live region, so a committed "Thought for Ns" row no longer advertises a toggle that does nothing
Leaving the agent monitor or session dashboard no longer reprints the conversation
An agent swap now commits its notice and greeting instead of holding them until the next prompt
A status dot no longer leaves a gap in the left accent bar
Customize the busy indicator verbs via the chat.spinnerVerbs setting (opt-in with chat.enableCustomSpinnerVerbs), with append and replace modes and optional verb links
Large tool outputs are saved in full under the session's `tool-outputs/` directory instead of clipped
Surface provider refusal reasons instead of a generic "failed to generate a response" error
Submitted prompts hide the input chevron when the prompt background distinguishes them in conversation history
Workspace `cli.json` settings now override global settings in the TUI
`--no-interactive` no longer hangs callers waiting for the run output to close
A non-interactive run resumed with `--resume-id` no longer reports the loaded conversation as its own output
API-key authentication now discovers non-commercial service endpoints correctly
Interrupting a `--no-interactive` run now writes a terminal `runError` with stage `interrupted` to `--output-format stream-json`, instead of ending the stream with no final record
Submitted prompts no longer extend the active response accent into the blank row before thinking
A `--no-interactive` run that is interrupted or terminated now stops the engine and the processes it started, instead of leaving them behind
Nameless subagents no longer appear as `undefined` in the agent panel
Sessions permanently failing with `TokenExpiredError` after an auto-update removed the running binary
Replayed failed tool cards no longer print a doubled output label under the output header
Session-start tool cards render below the banner and What's-new block at boot, adjacent to the conversation, instead of sandwiched between them
Agents without a configured model now honor saved model and effort defaults while agent-pinned models still win
Duplicate notifications no longer emitted when steering or skills files change
Mid-stream stalls during reasoning-only responses are automatically re-issued instead of failing the turn
Resumed sessions replay tool cards with their deterministic titles, real arguments, and tool IDs
SessionStart hook content is kept on every turn instead of dropping after the first
Enterprise MCP registries no longer fail with HTTP 403 on hosts that require a User-Agent
Active-tail accent no longer paints on wrap-disabled or lite surfaces that drop the left status bar
Per-turn usage footer now renders with a consistent leading blank line and no stray leading space whether the turn was committed live or replayed on resume
`/config` panel to view configured agents, MCP servers, powers, steering, skills, and hooks
`/sessions` dashboard to browse, search, resume and clean up past sessions
Kept completed turns visually stable when they move into preserved scrollback, preventing detached viewports from jumping or corrupting history
Selecting swap from the `/agent` menu without an agent name now opens the agent picker instead of failing with "Agent 'swap' not found"

Prevented preserved-scrollback turn completion from replaying terminal history while retaining full-width prompts with a leading â€º marker, tool output, iTerm alignment, and the bounded active-tail accent
Task list panel now shows the finished all-done state at the end of a run instead of vanishing, and clears it when a new prompt starts
Java code navigation in V2 now opens decompiled source for external libraries
Turn errors no longer display twice, and the error row's accent bar now matches its status dot color
MCP tool cards resolve their server identity from agent metadata instead of the display title
Session-start tool card no longer shows as cancelled when creating or resuming a session
